column1: # LARGE-ARTIFACTS.tsv — inventory of large model artifacts EXCLUDED from git (T-13, 2026-09-15)
# Files <=64MB: both columns are the full-file sha256 (tail column reads SAME-AS-HEAD).
# Directories: hashed as a DIR-MANIFEST (sha256 of sorted "relpath size mtime" listing) since a
# byte-range hash is undefined for a multi-file directory; both columns carry the same hash.
# Durability leg: rsync'd to /mnt/hdd/pk31-large-artifacts/aitrain1/<path> on pk31 (same host,
# separate volume — protects against accidental rm of the working tree, not disk failure).
